name: Negai no Yukue
source:
There were two shrines in the town of Kyunai.
Omi Shrine and Kumagaya Shrine.

Omi had been in the town since time immemorial.
Kumagaya was brand new.

The townfolk were excited by the erection of Kumagaya Shrine and gave it more attention.

One day the inner sanctum of Omi Shrine was disturbed, and the town was cursed.
Fearful people blamed young Aki and her mother.

Aki became friendless, in town and school.
Was there any way to dispel the curse?

A modern day otome love story. You work hard: now be helped by a young man. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE105853.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
久内町有两座神社。
近江神社和熊谷神社。

近江自古以来就居住在这座城镇。
熊谷是全新的。

熊谷神社的建立让镇民们兴奋不已，并给予了更多的关注。

有一天，近江神社的内殿被扰乱，整个城镇都受到了诅咒。
恐惧的人们将责任归咎于年轻的阿基和她的母亲。

阿基在城镇和学校都变得没有朋友。
有什么办法可以解除诅咒吗？

现代乙女爱情故事。你工作很努力：现在得到一个年轻人的帮助。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE105853.html]DLsite English[/url]]
